result.summary: Found 2 issues: a major broken restaurant image in the Popular section and a minor truncated restaurant name in the horizontally scrolling list.

issues.description: The 'Tokumaru Ramen Bar' card under 'Popular right now' shows a gray broken-image placeholder instead of an actual restaurant photo, while the €0 delivery badge and favorite heart still render on top of it.
issues.suggestion: Ensure the restaurant image URL loads correctly, add a retry/fallback branded placeholder, and avoid overlaying badges on failed image states.

issues.description: In the 'Fastest near you' carousel, the third restaurant name is clipped as 'Trattoria Piccol' at the right edge of the visible card.
issues.suggestion: Allow horizontal scrolling to reveal full card content, reduce card width slightly, or truncate with an ellipsis only after enough characters to remain meaningful.
